Open it in Excel, then save it: Excel calculates the totals and checks, and shows COMPLETE when nothing is missing. Then convert the saved file to XBRL on the publisher's site: the converter reads the values calculated by Excel.

suivi.export.tableau.dimensions.other: {kpis} KPI × {n} organisations · percentages from 0 to 100 · header: colour of the organisation level

suivi.export.tableau.dimensions_formules.other: {kpis} KPI × {n} organisations · percentages in Excel's % format · header: colour of the organisation level

suivi.export.tableau.legende_formules: Calculated cells: Excel formulas (or a figure with a comment saying why) · empty: to enter · Type: how the value is obtained
suivi.export.formules.principe_texte: The tool writes calculated KPIs and totals as formulas that cite the cells of their sources. If you change a value, Excel recalculates them (audit, simulation).
suivi.export.formules.regles_texte: The rules of the tool. Calculated KPI: its formula, with the cells of its sources in the same column (inherited emission factor: the cell of the organisation that carries it). Total: SUM of the attached organisations that the tool adds up (open during the period, N/A ignored). N/A source counted as 0 (KPI sheet): N(cell). Division: IF(AND(a=0,b=0),0,a/b), because 0 / 0 gives 0 and any other division by zero gives an error.
suivi.export.formules.valeurs_texte: A calculated cell keeps its figure, with a note saying why, when a formula would not give exactly the tool's figure: forced value, figure imported as is, value entered above the detail, cumulation of shorter periods, formula citing another period (N-1, P-1, a year), source missing from the export, recalculation different from the saved figure. N/A, empty cells, yes / no and lists stay values.
suivi.export.formules.ouverture_texte: Excel or LibreOffice calculates the formulas when it opens the file. A preview (email, phone) or Power BI can show these cells empty. For Power BI, use the “Database” export.
suivi.export.formules.bilan_texte: Cells as formulas: {n} · calculated cells kept as figures: {m}
suivi.export.erreur.trop_de_lignes: This export is too large for Excel: one sheet holds at most {max} rows. Choose the CSV format, or export one year at a time.
suivi.export.formules.raison.saisie_dess: value entered above the detail. It replaces the total of the attached organisations.
suivi.export.formules.raison.importe: figure imported as is (history of the former tool). It is the official figure.
suivi.export.formules.raison.forcee: forced value (with approval). It replaces the calculation.
suivi.export.formules.raison.cumul: cumulation of shorter periods (months, quarters…) that are not in this tab.
suivi.export.formules.raison.autre_perio: the formula cites another period ([ID@N-1], [ID@P-1] or a year).
suivi.export.formules.raison.source_abse: a source is not in the export (KPI or organisation not chosen, value not exported or outside your scope).
suivi.export.formules.raison.ecart: the calculation with the cells of the tab does not give the saved figure (closed period, settings changed since).
suivi.export.formules.raison.trop_long: the formula would be too long for Excel.
suivi.export.tableau.ecarts_texte: With the N-1 column: the value is in orange when the variance is above the campaign threshold.
suivi.export.tableau.impression_texte: A4 landscape, headers repeated on each page. Beyond 8 organisations, several pages wide, with the KPI repeated on the left of each page.
suivi.export.tableau.lecture_texte: One sheet per period: KPIs in rows, organisations in columns. The legend at the top of each sheet shows the colours. Type: how the value is obtained (entry, calculation, inherited parameter).
suivi.export.tableau.legende: Empty: to enter · Type: how the value is obtained (entry, calculation, inherited parameter)
suivi.export.tableau.themes_texte: Rows grouped by theme and sub-theme. To collapse them, click the buttons 1, 2, 3 on the left.

suivi.fichier.erreur.excel_illisible: The tool cannot read this Excel file. Save it as .xlsx, then try again.

suivi.fichier.erreur.trop_gros_ouvert: This Excel file is too large once opened (more than {mo} MB). Remove the sheets, rows, or columns that you do not need, then try again.

suivi.rejets.bandeau2.other: {n} rejected rows. You can also correct them in the import preview.

suivi.relances.intro.message_perimetre: One message per person, with everything they still have to enter or validate within your scope. Nobody else receives a copy.
suivi.relances.marquer.aide: Notes in the history a reminder made outside the tool (phone, messaging app)
suivi.relances.message_trop_long: This message is too long to open in your email app. Copy it, then paste it into a new email.

suivi.relances.msg.auto_jours.one: Automatic reminders: {jours} day before the end of data entry.
suivi.relances.msg.auto_jours.other: Automatic reminders: {jours} days before the end of data entry.

suivi.relances.msg.echecs.one: {n} reminder was not sent ({noms}): {cause}. Contact your IT team.
suivi.relances.msg.echecs.other: {n} reminders were not sent ({noms}): {cause}. Contact your IT team.

suivi.relances.msg.emails_inactifs: Emails are not set up, so nothing was sent. Write to each person with your email app (“Write” link in the list).
suivi.relances.msg.essai_echec: The test was not sent: {cause}. Contact your IT team (email settings in Settings › Hosting).
suivi.relances.msg.marquee: Reminder to {destinataire} noted in the history.
suivi.relances.msg.pas_ouverte: The tool sends reminders only for a campaign that is open for data entry.
suivi.relances.msg.retiree: Reminder to {destinataire} removed from the history.
suivi.relances.msg.rien_pour_personne: Nothing to remind this person about.
suivi.relances.msg.sans_adresse: No email address, so no reminder: {noms}.
suivi.relances.portee.aide: One email per person, with what they still have to do in the chosen frameworks. A KPI shared by several frameworks appears once.
suivi.relances.presel.org: Selected in advance: the people of {organisation} and of the organisations attached to it
suivi.relances.presel.org_autres: Selected in advance: the people of {organisation} and of the organisations attached to it. The other people stay in the list, not selected.
suivi.relances.presel.personne_autres: Selected in advance: {personne}. The other people stay in the list, not selected.
suivi.relances.refus.annuler: Only the person who noted a reminder by hand can cancel it.
suivi.relances.refus.modele: Only an administrator can change the reminder template.
suivi.relances.refus.page: Only administrators and validators can open this page.
suivi.relances.rien: Nobody has anything left to enter: everything is validated.
suivi.relances.sans_smtp.aide: Write to each person with your email app. “Write” gives their address, the subject, and the message to copy. After the reminder, click “Mark as reminded” to note it in the history and in “Last reminder”.
suivi.relances.sans_smtp.it_admin: Your IT team must provide the sending account (SMTP):
suivi.relances.sans_smtp.it_autre: An administrator can ask IT to turn them on.
suivi.relances.sans_smtp.titre: Emails are not set up yet: nothing is sent from this page.
suivi.remplir.bandeau1: Enter your answers in the yellow cells: Value (no unit, percentage from 0 to 100), N/A (“Yes” if the KPI does not apply, with a comment), Comment.
suivi.remplir.bandeau2: Then import the file in Import / Export › Import values. A preview shows everything before saving. An empty cell deletes nothing.
suivi.remplir.bandeau_definitions: KPI definition: note on its name, “Definitions” sheet.
suivi.remplir.definitions_aide: What to include or exclude for each KPI.
suivi.remplir.lire.ajouter_texte: Unprotect the sheet (Review › Unprotect Sheet, no password). Then enter the KPI ID, the organisation (name or import label), and the period.
suivi.remplir.lire.campagne_a_indiquer: to enter in the Period (or Year) column
suivi.remplir.lire.cellule_vide_texte: An empty value or comment deletes nothing: the tool skips the row.
suivi.remplir.lire.definitions_texte: Note on each KPI name, and “Definitions” sheet.
suivi.remplir.lire.deposer_texte: Import / Export › Import values: a preview shows what the tool creates, changes, or rejects. Nothing is saved before you confirm. You can download the rejected rows, correct them, and import them again.
suivi.remplir.lire.facultatives_texte: N/A, Comment, Framework (the tool rejects the row if the KPI is not in this framework). The tool ignores the other columns (Fill status, To check, Theme…).
suivi.remplir.lire.na_texte: “Yes” if the KPI does not apply. Explain why in the comment.
suivi.remplir.lire.nombres_texte: Decimal comma or point (1 234,5 or 1234.5). No unit in the cell.
suivi.remplir.lire.obligatoires_texte: KPI ID, Organisation, Value. Also accepted: “Id”, “Result”. “Organisation code” (grey) identifies the organisation before its name. Do not change it, even if the name changes.
suivi.remplir.lire.oui_non_texte: Choose from the list of the cell, or enter the answer in any language of the tool.
suivi.remplir.lire.periode_texte: “2026”, “S1 2026”, “Q1 2026”, “March 2026” (or “03/2026”). If there is no period, the “Year” column. If there is no year, the campaign chosen at import.
suivi.remplir.lire.preuves_texte: Add the evidence in the tool (Data entry page), not in this file.
suivi.remplir.lire.remplir_texte: Yellow cells only: “Value”, “N/A” and “Comment”. The other cells are protected (no password), so that the file stays correct.
suivi.remplir.lire.verifier_texte: “Fill status” shows what is left to fill in. “To check” shows a large variance with the comparison period (comment required) and the evidence to add in the tool.
suivi.remplir.preuve: Evidence to add in the tool.
suivi.remplir.validation.nombre: Enter a number, without a unit.
suivi.remplir.validation.pourcentage: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 (35 for 35%).

suivi.restes_sans_spoc.one: Nobody to remind: the remaining cell has no SPOC, so nobody is in charge of it.
suivi.restes_sans_spoc.other: Nobody to remind: the {n} remaining cells have no SPOC, so nobody is in charge of them.

suivi.tdb.a_relancer.aide_admin: What each person receives: everything they still have to do
suivi.tdb.a_relancer.aide_perimetre: What each person receives: everything they still have to do within your scope
suivi.tdb.a_relancer.rien: Nobody has anything left to enter: everything is validated.
suivi.tdb.aucune_case: No cell within your scope for this campaign.
suivi.tdb.barre.detail_attendu: {valide} validated, {brouillon} drafts, {a_saisir} to fill in. Line: pace expected to date ({attendu}%)
suivi.tdb.campagnes.aide: Same cells as the rate at the top of the page: optional KPIs do not count. A value shared by two frameworks of the same frequency is entered once.

suivi.tdb.detail.propres.one: its own KPIs: {valide} out of {total} validated
suivi.tdb.detail.propres.other: its own KPIs: {valide} out of {total} validated

suivi.tdb.echeance.preparation: data entry is not open yet
suivi.tdb.facultatifs.note: (validated, including N/A, and not counted in the rate or in reminders)
suivi.tdb.methode.perimetre_admin: All the expected cells: each KPI to fill in and each active emission factor, for each active organisation of the level at which it is entered.
suivi.tdb.methode.retard: An organisation is late when the rate of its own KPIs is more than {tolerance} points below the expected pace. The expected pace is the share of the data entry time that has passed ({attendu}%). An organisation that groups others shows how many of them are late.
suivi.tdb.methode.taux: Rate = validated values (including N/A) ÷ expected cells. The optional KPIs of the framework do not count in the rate, the late organisations, or the reminders. You can still enter them.
suivi.tdb.par_org.aide: An organisation that groups others also counts their cells. Its rate is the rate of the whole group.
suivi.tdb.relancer_aria_prepare: Remind {personne} (prepare the email, emails not set up yet)

suivi.tdb.sans_spoc.one: {n} cell without a SPOC: nobody is in charge of it, so nobody gets a reminder.
suivi.tdb.sans_spoc.other: {n} cells without a SPOC: nobody is in charge of them, so nobody gets a reminder.

suivi.tdb.sans_spoc.aide: nobody is in charge of these cells
suivi.echanges.kpi.aucune_liste: No KPI list yet. Click “Choose the KPIs”, select the KPIs, then click “Save this list”. You can also create a list in

suivi.echanges.importer.fond.attente.one: Another import goes before yours: yours starts right after.
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.attente.other: {n} other imports go before yours: yours starts right after.

suivi.echanges.importer.fond.arret_deman: Stop requested: the import stops at the end of the current block ({n} / {total} rows).
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.quitter: You can leave this page. The import continues on the server, and other people can continue their data entry. To see the result, come back to Import / Export › Import values.
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.arreter_aid: The import stops at the end of the current block (100 rows). The rows already written stay saved.
The import has not started yet: nothing is written.
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.annule: Import stopped before it started: nothing was written.
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.arrete: Import stopped at your request after {n} rows out of {total}. The rows already written stay saved, and the rest of the file is not imported. To finish, import the same file again. The tool then counts the values already imported as “unchanged”.

suivi.echanges.importer.fond.interrompu.one: The server restarted twice in a row during the import. The import stopped after {n} value written out of {total}. The values already written stay saved. To finish, import the same file again. The tool then counts the values already imported as “unchanged”.
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.interrompu.other: The server restarted twice in a row during the import. The import stopped after {n} values written out of {total}. The values already written stay saved. To finish, import the same file again. The tool then counts the values already imported as “unchanged”.

suivi.echanges.importer.fond.echec.one: The import stopped because of an error after {n} value written. The values already written stay saved. The details below are also in the server log, for your IT team.
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.echec.other: The import stopped because of an error after {n} values written. The values already written stay saved. The details below are also in the server log, for your IT team.

suivi.echanges.importer.fond.reprise: After a server restart, the import started again from the beginning of the file. Nothing was written twice.
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.deja: You already have an import in progress ({nom}). Wait until it ends, or stop it, before you start another one.
suivi.echanges.importer.fond.apercu: This file has more than {seuil} rows, so the import runs in the background, with a progress bar. You can leave the page during the import.
suivi.conso.intro: Each organisation adds up the organisations it groups. Expand an organisation to see where its total comes from, or click a value to show its details.
suivi.conso.aucun_kpi: No numeric KPI to show for this choice: choose another theme or list.
suivi.conso.aucune_organisation: No organisation in your scope for these KPIs.

suivi.conso.trop_de_kpi.one: {n} more KPI is not shown ({max} columns at most): choose a sub-theme or a shorter list.
suivi.conso.trop_de_kpi.other: {n} more KPIs are not shown ({max} columns at most): choose a sub-theme or a shorter list.

suivi.tdb.a_faire.emails: You can prepare reminders, but the tool does not send them. Your IT team must provide the sending account (SMTP).
suivi.tdb.par_org.aide_contributeur: The organisations where KPIs are assigned to you. An organisation that groups others also counts their cells.

suivi.tdb.a_faire.retards.one: {n} organisation behind the expected pace (more than {tolerance} points below).
suivi.tdb.a_faire.retards.other: {n} organisations behind the expected pace (more than {tolerance} points below).

suivi.conso.legende.erreur: calculation error (click the value to show the cause)

suivi.conso.partiel_note.one: Partial total: {n} organisation has no value yet.
suivi.conso.partiel_note.other: Partial total: {n} organisations have no value yet.

suivi.conso.tout_vide.one: The KPI of this choice has no value yet. To show it anyway, clear “Hide empty KPIs”.
suivi.conso.tout_vide.other: The {n} KPIs of this choice have no value yet. To show them anyway, clear “Hide empty KPIs”.

suivi.conso.trop_de_kpi_lignes.one: {n} more KPI is not shown ({max} rows at most): choose a sub-theme or a shorter list.
suivi.conso.trop_de_kpi_lignes.other: {n} more KPIs are not shown ({max} rows at most): choose a sub-theme or a shorter list.

suivi.remplir.validation.na: Enter Yes for “not applicable”, or leave the cell empty.
suivi.remplir.aide.na: Yes if the KPI does not apply here (a comment is then required).
suivi.remplir.aide.nombre: A number only, without a unit.
suivi.remplir.aide.nombre_unite: A number in {unite}, without the unit.
suivi.remplir.aide.liste: Choose an answer from the list.
suivi.echanges.listes.intro_lecture: A list groups the KPIs that you follow often. Choose it in one click in an export.
suivi.export.legende.saisie_aide: Value entered in the tool, or imported.
suivi.export.legende.calculee_aide: Obtained by a formula, or by adding up the organisations below.
suivi.export.legende.calculee_formules_a: Excel formula that cites the cells of its sources. A figure with a comment when a formula would not give exactly the figure of the tool.
suivi.export.legende.brouillon_aide: Entry not yet validated by the contributor.
suivi.export.legende.comparaison_aide: Value of the comparison period, to the right of each organisation.
suivi.export.legende.ecart_aide: Relative variance with {comparaison}, (value − {comparaison}) / {comparaison}, beyond the campaign threshold: to be explained.
suivi.export.legende.ecart_revue_aide: Relative variance with the comparison period, (value − N-1) / N-1, beyond the campaign threshold: to be explained.
suivi.export.legende.sans_objet_aide: No value possible here: KPI entered lower in the tree, or not added up above.
suivi.export.legende.statut_valide_aide: The contributor declared the entry complete (this is not a check of its accuracy).
suivi.export.redige.a_lire: Written answers (qualitative KPIs) are in the “Written answers” sheet, as plain text: one row per KPI, organisation and period.
suivi.export.redige.bandeau: One row per KPI, organisation and period, as plain text (the tool's headings, lists and tables put back into lines).

suivi.echanges.importer.resultat.non_imp.one: {n} row was not imported: download it to correct it.
suivi.echanges.importer.resultat.non_imp.other: {n} rows were not imported: download them to correct them.

suivi.echanges.export.apercu_tableau_not: The Excel file has a different layout: one sheet per period, one column per organisation.
suivi.echanges.importer.apercu.autres_li: Rows only counted: {inchangees} identical to the tool, {ignorees} ignored (empty value, calculated KPI, aggregated total).
suivi.importer.erreur.export_lisible: This file is a “Table” or “Review” export. You can read it in Excel, but you cannot import it. To correct values with a file, use the file to fill in (step 1) or the “Database” export.

suivi.echanges.importer.a_importer.limit.one: The preview shows only the first {n} rows. The import saves all {total} rows to save.
suivi.echanges.importer.a_importer.limit.other: The preview shows only the first {n} rows. The import saves all {total} rows to save.

suivi.importer.motif.na_sans_commentaire: N/A without a comment: add a comment before you validate.
suivi.export.legende.statut_calcule_aide: Calculated KPI or total: obtained automatically, nothing to validate.
suivi.export.legende.statut_incomplet_ai: Calculated KPI with at least one source still missing.
suivi.remplir.lire.redige_texte: Formatted free text: # for a heading, ** around a word for bold, - at the start of a line for a list, | for a table. Keep these signs. For a new line in the cell, press Alt+Enter (Ctrl+Option+Enter on a Mac). 20,000 characters at most.
suivi.relances.modele.texte_fourni_confi: Go back to the default text? Your subject and message, in every language, are replaced. You cannot undo this.
suivi.echanges.importer.etape1.vide_aide: The empty file has the same columns, without your KPIs. Use it when your values come from another tool (HR software, accounting…): paste them into the columns, then import the file.
suivi.echanges.kpi.coller_aide: One code per line, or separated by commas (for example, a column copied from Excel).
suivi.officiel.msg.gps: {site}: GPS coordinates “{valeur}” not used (write latitude, longitude, e.g. 48.85661, 2.35222).

suivi.echanges.exports.fond.aide.one: Large files are prepared on the server. You can leave this page: each file waits for you here for {n} day, then it is deleted.
suivi.echanges.exports.fond.aide.other: Large files are prepared on the server. You can leave this page: each file waits for you here for {n} days, then it is deleted.

suivi.echanges.exports.fond.echec: The file could not be prepared. Try again. If it fails again, tell your administrator.
suivi.echanges.exports.fond.interrompu: Stopped by a server restart. Download the export again.
suivi.echanges.exports.fond.remplir_tous: File to fill in – all my frameworks
suivi.echanges.msg.export_fond: “{nom}” is a large file, so it is prepared on the server. You will find it below, in “Large files”.
suivi.echanges.msg.export_fond_deja: A file is already being prepared for you: “{nom}”. Ask for the next one when it is ready.

suivi.echanges.msg.export_fond_expire.one: This file is no longer available (large files are kept {n} day). Download the export again.
suivi.echanges.msg.export_fond_expire.other: This file is no longer available (large files are kept {n} days). Download the export again.

suivi.echanges.msg.export_fond_absent: This file is no longer on the server: a backup was restored, or the data was copied to another installation, and large files are never copied. Download the export again.
suivi.echanges.msg.export_fond_droits: Your access has changed since you asked for this file, so it was deleted. Download the export again.
suivi.export.presentation.audit_aide: For an audit: one row per KPI and organisation with the value, status, who entered and validated it, overridden value, comment, evidence, consistency alerts and their justifications, plus the History and Evidence sheets. Read only. For administrators and auditors.
suivi.export.audit.refus: The audit file is for administrators and auditors.
suivi.export.audit.forcage_texte: {justification} (requested by {demandeur} on {date_demande}; accepted by {traite_par} on {date_traitement}; calculated result replaced: {calculee})
suivi.export.audit.bulle_valeur: Percentages are shown from 0 to 100. N/A means not applicable. A value that the calculation gave is marked in the Source column.
suivi.export.audit.lire.cases_texte: One row per KPI and organisation for each period exported: codes and names, value and unit, previous-year value and variance, status and source, whether the value was overridden, comment, who entered and validated it and when, evidence, consistency alerts with their justifications and decisions, and the confidentiality of the KPI.
suivi.export.audit.lire.historique_texte: {n} changes recorded for these cells, oldest first: who changed what, when, from which value to which. The reference (H-…) is the one of the History page.
suivi.export.audit.lire.preuves_texte: {n} evidence files attached to these cells: file name, size in bytes, who added it and when. The files themselves are not in this workbook.
suivi.export.audit.lire.alertes_texte: Alerts are numbered (1, 2…) in the same way in the three alert columns of the Audit sheet. Only the alerts that the person who exports can see are listed.
suivi.export.audit.lire.lecture_seule_te: Making this file changes nothing in the tool. It is a copy: a later change in the tool is not in this file.
suivi.export.audit.lire.coupe_texte: The History sheet holds the first {n} changes only (the limit of a sheet). Export fewer organisations or one period to see them all.
suivi.certificat.imprimer_aide: Prints this page on A4 or Letter. In the print window, choose “Save as PDF” to keep a file.
suivi.certificat.refus: The closing certificate is for administrators and auditors.
suivi.certificat.partiel.couvre: It covers {organisations} and the organisations below them.
suivi.certificat.partiel.couvre_aucune: No organisation in your scope is part of this campaign.
suivi.certificat.partiel.explication: Every figure on this page counts only the organisations you can see. The totals of the organisations above them are not counted.
suivi.certificat.partiel.empreinte: This fingerprint is computed only on the values of the organisations you can see. It is different from the fingerprint of the full certificate, which covers every organisation of the campaign. Compare it only with another partial certificate for the same organisations.
suivi.certificat.campagne.autres: Other campaigns on the same period
suivi.certificat.cloture.inconnue: The history of this installation does not keep who closed this campaign, nor when.
suivi.certificat.reouverture.non: This campaign has not been reopened.
suivi.certificat.reouverture.mode_gardes: Mode of the last reopening: figures of the time kept.
suivi.certificat.reouverture.mode_recalc: Mode of the last reopening: recalculated with today's organisation.
suivi.certificat.perimetre.note: An organisation counts as open in the period when it was active at some point in it, from its opening date. The tree is the one kept at the closing.
suivi.certificat.remplissage.phrase: {valides} of {attendues} expected cells are validated (N/A included).
suivi.certificat.empreinte.prouve: The fingerprint is a SHA-256 hash computed on every value of this campaign (KPI, organisation, value, N/A, text), in a fixed order. If a single figure changes, the fingerprint changes.
suivi.certificat.empreinte.verifier: To check, open the certificate again later and compare the fingerprints: if they are the same, no figure has changed. The status, the author and the dates are not part of it.
suivi.importer.motif.calcule_forcer: Calculated KPI: the imported value will replace the calculated result, as an overridden value.
suivi.importer.motif.calcule_sans_droit: Calculated KPI: only an administrator or a validator of this organisation can replace its result. Ask for an overridden value from the cell.
suivi.importer.motif.calcule_non_force: Calculated KPI: not imported, because you did not choose to force these values.
suivi.echange.calcule_ouverte: Calculated KPI in a period that is not closed (force it in the tool)

suivi.echanges.importer.forcer.texte.one: The tool calculates this cell. If you force the value, it replaces the calculated result until someone goes back to the calculation.
suivi.echanges.importer.forcer.texte.other: The tool calculates these cells. If you force the values, they replace the calculated results until someone goes back to the calculation.

suivi.echanges.importer.forcer.oui_aide: Each value becomes a validated overridden value. Justification: the comment of the row, otherwise the file name. Totals and formulas that use it are calculated again.
suivi.echanges.importer.forcer.non_aide: The calculation stays as it is. The other rows are imported.

suivi.echanges.importer.resultat.forcees.one: {n} value of a calculated KPI is now an overridden value.
suivi.echanges.importer.resultat.forcees.other: {n} values of calculated KPIs are now overridden values.

suivi.echanges.importer.resultat.non_for.one: {n} row for a calculated KPI was not imported: you did not choose to force it.
suivi.echanges.importer.resultat.non_for.other: {n} rows for calculated KPIs were not imported: you did not choose to force them.

suivi.importer.motif.calcule_org_fermee: Calculated KPI: the organisation is closed, so its result cannot be overridden.
suivi.officiel.msg.monnaie: {kpi}: amount not written. Its unit “{unite}” is not the unit of the template in the currency of the report ({monnaie}). The tool converts no values: enter the amount in {monnaie}, or check the reference currency in Administration › Frameworks and KPIs › Units and formats.
